svg.title: Pipeline diagram: input meshes to video model with regularization, noise selection, VAE encoder, operation and gradient arrows
svg.desc: Base-frame inventory and construction notes: f01 contains the Input Meshes rounded label and outgoing arrow. f02 contains the first dashed perspective 3D box with checker floor, a suited human, table, manipulation rod, and caption Converted 3D-GS. f03 contains a similar blue dashed 4D representation box with translucent motion ghosts, current human/table, green motion markers, and caption 4D Representation (Sec 3.3). f04 contains a peach rounded Spatial + Temporal Smoothness Regularization box. f05 contains three rendered-video slanted panels, each with a small human/table scene, and the Render label with operation/gradient curved arrows from the 4D representation and regularization area. f06 contains the yellow VAE Encoder wedge. f07 contains the red noise-level curve plot with axes and selection text. f08 contains the Operation/Gradient legend. f09 contains the yellow Video Model block with orange vertical capsules and bottom caption. A dashed gradient path runs from the video model region back to the rendering/4D region; solid operation arrows advance left-to-right.
